jobs.name: PlayerAuctions fee update watchdog
jobs.prompt: Check the PlayerAuctions seller-fee page for the fee-structure update announced effective August 19, 2026 (PlayerAuctions - Seller Fees article). Run the watchdog script check_playerauctions_fees.py and report its output. If the script prints an ALERT (fee change detected), summarize what changed and list the RankValut docs that need updating (Phase 0 Decision Pack §5.2, Competitor Fee and Protection Benchmark, Valut System and Fee Specification §1.1). If it prints INFO or nothing, keep the reply to one line confirming the check ran with no change. If it prints the manual-check reminder, say the page is Cloudflare-blocked and needs a manual check.
